MARKET SUMMARY
INDIA
The Indian ship recycling market remained subdued during the week, with weak local
demand for end products continuing to weigh on overall sentiment. Local steel prices have shown some stability; however, current levels are expected to
be temporary as demand for end products remains weak. Market activity may soften further in the coming weeks as weak domestic demand for
end products is expected to continue limiting market momentum.
